_why: A pinned, hand-updated export of the sister repository's DORA register. Updating it is deliberately manual: that update is the moment drift becomes visible, and automation would hide it. Nothing reads the other repository at test time.
_caveat: The sister register is verified against the primary text from the Publications Office Cellar repository, and its build fails if a label drifts from the official heading. That makes a comparison here meaningful; it still says nothing about whether an obligation applies to a given system.
